text:
amy: Hey — saw a short burst of 502s from the gateway hitting /v1/generate around 08:24 UTC. Rate jumped to ~1.8% for ~3m. Where's the best place to pull traces/logs/dash links to triage? worried the alert is going to spam.
josh: Grafana -> Service Errors dash has a useful "5xx by route" panel: https://grafana.redwood.internal/d/abcd/service-errors?orgId=1
Also check APM traces in Datadog: https://app.datadoghq.com/apm/traces?query=service:gateway%20env:prod
nora: Pinned list for this kind of thing:
- Grafana panel above
- Kibana logs: https://kibana.redwood.internal/app/discover#/doc/logs
- Runbook: https://confluence.internal/redwood/runbooks/502-gateway-troubleshoot
amy: thx — can you drop the Kibana query here? would like to filter to that 08:20-08:30 window and route.
josh: try this in Kibana (time range 08:20-08:30 UTC):
```
service.keyword: "gateway" AND status_code: 502 AND http.request.path: "/v1/generate"
| sort @timestamp desc
```
Also in Datadog APM add tag filter: `http.route:/v1/generate` and look for downstream span errors.
nora: note: sometimes these are client cancellations or the healthcheck path. If that's the case the alert is noisy. Current alert config is 1% over 1m which catches tiny bursts.
observability-bot: Alert ERR_RATE_502_GATEWAY current configuration: threshold=1% over 1m. Recent firing at 2026-03-17T08:24:xxZ (count=34, total_reqs=1890). Related runbook: https://confluence.internal/redwood/runbooks/502-gateway-troubleshoot
amy: OK — what tuning do you recommend? 5m window? exclude healthcheck UA?
josh: I recommend: >= 0.5% over 5m AND minimum 20 errors. Also add exclude: `http.request.path: "/hc" OR user_agent.keyword: "arn:elb-healthcheck"` to reduce known noise. If it still fires, check Datadog flamegraphs for model-proxy upstream timeouts.
nora: Also add a dashboard panel for client_ip heatmap to see if single IP or bot is causing spike. If it's a single IP, rate-limit/iptables rule might be warranted.
amy: Can someone quiet the alert while I open a PR to change the alert rule? I'll attach example traces and a few log samples.
devops-oncall: I'll quiet the alert for 10m and set a follow-up task. Quieting done. Pager suppressed.
josh: Quick trace snippet to look for (Datadog trace span tags):
```
span.service: model-proxy
span.error: true
error.type: upstream_timeout
http.status_code: 502
upstream.host: model-backend-12
```
amy: Perfect. I'll collect 3 trace ids and add to the ticket + PR for alert tune. Thanks all :thumbsup:
nora: FYI, after PR we should backfill a 30d eval in dashboard to ensure we don't miss smaller regressions. Also add a note in the runbook to check upstream error ratios.
amy: will do. filing now and pinging infra for the PR review.
